notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least eight.
description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
